decisions.reason: Delaying table-of-contents page-number updates until book size is finalized does not change illustration selection, placement, coverage, or review criteria.
The source establishes timing for updating table-of-contents page numbers, not a change to the paperback format or general interior-layout requirement.
The table-of-contents numbering schedule does not alter Chapter 12 heading hierarchy, capitalization, or typography.
The source decision concerns pagination timing and does not change manuscript wording, approved passages, or the copyediting goal.
The timing of table-of-contents page-number updates has no necessary effect on removal or treatment of the literal newline artifact in the book title.
The source does not change the copyright-page publisher line or its layout.
The pagination-timing decision does not resolve or modify the uncertainty about whether the interior title page should include an image.
Updating table-of-contents page numbers after size finalization does not change the required back matter or author copy.
The source decision affects table-of-contents pagination timing only and does not change the paperback cover artifact, content, or format.
